RAMISETTI VENKATA NAGA RAMESH Mobile: +91-9912928868 Email: rameshramisetti7996@gmail.com

NETWORK ENGINEER WITH 5 YEARS OF EXPERIENCE IN NETWORK Routing & NRS-1 certified (28877), CCNA CERTIFIED ID(CSCO13468004).

Career Objective:

IP/MPLS networking, broadband technologies, and network integration to contribute to a growth-oriented organization while continuously enhancing my technical and leadership skills.

To

leverage my expertise

in

Technical Skills:

➢ Routing Protocols: OSPF, BGP, ISIS, Static Routing ➢ MPLS Technologies: MPLS, LDP, VPRN, VPLS, L2VPN & L3VPN ➢ Broadband Technologies: BNG, DHCP, PPPoE, AAA, Tacacs, DNS ➢ Switching: VLAN, STP, VTP ➢ Operating Systems: Nokia SR OS & Cisco IOS ➢ Platforms:7250 IXR 10, 7750 SCR2 & 7750 SR-1, Cisco routing & switching ➢ CCNA, NRS-1 & NRS-2

Technical certification:

Nokia Network Routing Specialist I (NRS-I) – ID: 28877

Cisco Certified Network Associate (CCNA) – CSCO13468004

Work Experience (5 years):

➢ Present Organization: Nokia Solutions Pvt Ltd.

Payroll: STL Digitals Ltd Employment Tenure: 22-July-2024 to till date Designation: Sr.Network Integration Engineer

➢ Previous Organization:

Name of Organization: SUPREME SOLUTIONS PRIVATE LIMITED Employment Tenure: 01-Dec-2021 to 20-July-2024

Designation: Network Engineer

Job Responsibility at Nokia Solutions Pvt LTD:

Payroll: STL Digitals

Designation (Sr.Network Engineer):

Project: Airtel FWA BNG (Airtel Fixed Wireless and Broadband Network) (client Bharti Airtel):

Role: Coordination with upstream service providers and clients for bandwidth delivery and issues. Handling Routing & Switching. Configuration end to end nodes, integrating nodes successfully with all test cases pass & successfully participated in the deployment and integration of Nokia FWA BNG nodes for Bharti Airtel's Fixed Wireless Access network.

➢

I have been part of team that have played vital role in integrating the Nokia FWA BNG Routers & switches in one of the largest ISPs of India (Bharti Airtel).

➢ Working as network implementation / Migration Engineer. ➢ Conducting Proof of Concept (PoC) activities for new network deployments ➢ Configure services, like BGP, LDP, MPLS, VPRN, VPLS, OSPF on Nokia SR series routers. ➢ Software upgradation of Nokia Core Boxes through remote. ➢ Performing protocol-level debugging and log analysis for issue resolution ➢ Creating link aggregate LAG, LACP Active as per design. ➢ Preparation of migration strategy and discuss with customer. ➢ Part of preparing MOP’s, HLD, LLD as per configuration requirement from customer. ➢ Configuration of BNG (Broadband Network Gateway) with DHCP and creating subscriber interfaces. ➢ Acceptance test preparation and taking confirmation from customer or writing. ➢ Performed all the test cases like LI integration, AAA integration, Tacacs Integration, alarm testing

with NSP, PPP sessions & IPOE sessions as per the customer requirements.

➢ Delivering 5G network along with 4G to PPPoe & IPoE customers. ➢ Documenting all configuration changes and processes through change

management processes

➢ Joining bridge calls during connectivity issues and analyzing the issues to work with

other teams

➢ Configuration/ Troubleshooting of various IGP/EGP protocols (BGP, MPLS, ISIS,

L2VPN, L3VPN)

Job Responsibility at SUPREME Solutions Pvt LTD: Designation (Network Engineer): Working for Super Core Project (BSNL) & CUP’s BNG (BSNL)

Role: Coordination with upstream service providers and clients for bandwidth delivery and issues. Handling Routing & Switching. Configuration & Troubleshooting on Nokia Devices. Monitoring the network using various tools which include Nokia-EMS, Whatsup gold & Solar-wind etc.

➢

I have been part of team that has played vital role in integrating the Super Core Routers in one of the largest ISPs of India (BSNL).

➢ As per the role assigned to me, I have ensured the successful migration of existing

BSNL routers with latest state-of-the-art technology (Nokia SCR).

➢ Apart from implementation, along with the team I have ensured to plan the entire

➢

future operations for the benefit of the project and the client. I have ensured to meet all the deadlines/targets assigned to me & I being part of team have streamlined entire operations.

➢ Planning migration strategy of links/ Devices as per customer requirement ➢ Implemented NOKIA SCR devices in BSNL MPLS Network ➢ Routing Protocols OSPF, ISIS and BGP in MPLS Network. ➢ Working as implementation / Migration Engineer. ➢ Migration of MPLS Core & Internet Gateways from legacy Huawei to Nokia Products. ➢ Software upgrades for SR7750 & 7250 IXR products ➢ Worked in Operations & Maintenance of SCR Project ➢ Handling Configuration Change Requests from Clients in time to meet SLA ➢ Taking utilization reports in various network devices periodically. ➢ Raising tickets with ISPs and OEM & Device vendors for any software/Hardware

failure and coordinating with them to resolve the issue

➢ Documenting all configuration changes and processes through change

management process

➢ Monitoring the network using various tools which include MRTG and Nokia-EMS,

Whatsup gold & Solar-wind etc.

➢ Joining bridge calls during connectivity issues and analyzing the issues to work with

other teams

➢ Configuration/ Troubleshooting of various IGP/EGP protocols (BGP, MPLS, ISIS,

L2VPN, L3VPN)

➢ Coordinate with vendors for changes network, adhered to the SLAs timely field

support, holding planned events for any major events or Outages.

➢ Part of Network operations team is responsible for Monitoring,

troubleshooting, Investigating, diagnosing, and resolving all network problems.

Key Achievements:

➢ Successfully integrated Nokia FWA BNG infrastructure for Bharti Airtel ➢ Participated in BSNL Super Core MPLS migration from Huawei to Nokia platforms. ➢ Performed BNG validation including AAA, TACACS+, LI, PPPoE, and IPoE testing. ➢ Executed multiple network migrations with minimal service impact. ➢ Supported large-scale ISP backbone and broadband network deployments.

Educational Qualification

➢ Completed B. Tech (CSE) from NRIIT college (JNTUK) ➢ SSC from SFS High School, Agiripalli

STRENGTHS:

➢ Ability to work in a team with diverse backgrounds. ➢ Strong commitment to quality ➢

I am willing to learn and adapt to new opportunities and challenges.

Date:

Place:

(R.V.N Ramesh)
